regime_context: The detector shows a broad (65% eligible), non-one-narrative US tape with Memory/HBM decisively ranked #1 but crowded and on only 0.44 durability; precious-metals miners (silver, gold, PGM) cluster in ranks 2-5 with higher durability and breadth. Gate discipline has helped historically here (gate_helps=true), but cross-sectional momentum carries no forward edge, so the read is a focus/durability lens, not a forecast.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the precious-metals miner cluster (SIL/GDX/PPLT, ranks 2-5) widens its breadth and durability over memory leadership: if Gold Miners holds durability above 0.7 and breadth above 0.8 while Memory's durability stays under 0.5 through the next two weeks, the rotation leg would be retired with a confirmed handoff to metals leadership; if Memory regains breadth above 0.3, the watch would also be retired.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners (GDX) sits rank 4 with the strongest coherent trend profile among the top themes: durability_bar 0.76 (highest in the eligible top-6), breadth 0.917 (broad participation), hurst_tag 'trend', and uncrowded (crowding_z 0.34). It is the cleanest 'staying power' candidate consistent with the validated absolute-trend gate. Not a return forecast — merely the most durable current leadership among materials themes.
theses.dissent: Precious metals miners are high-beta to real yields and the dollar; any hawkish re-pricing or risk-on equity rally could undercut them quickly despite trend-health.

falsifier.text: GDX closes 5% off its high while the S&P 500 is flat or up over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners (SIL) is rank 2 and the challenger in the rotation read, with durability_bar 0.66 and breadth 0.75 — both above the crowded #1 memory theme — and it is uncrowded (z 0.69). It pairs with the gold-miner trend but carries a higher beta and thinner liquidity penalty; direction positive, durability weaker than gold.
theses.dissent: Silver miners often lead early and fade hardest on industrial-demand disappointment; 0.66 durability is not high by trend standards.

falsifier.text: SIL underperforms GDX by 6% over the next 30 trading days

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory is the dominant rank-#1 theme but is flagged crowded (z 1.47), has the lowest durability_bar in the top-5 (0.44), zero breadth (0.0), hurst 'mixed', and r10 already 0.1021. Crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade — so the honest lean is avoid (no new long) rather than underweight, respecting the guardrail against fading the leader on crowding.
theses.dissent: The single strongest score in the book with high absolute momentum; leadership concentration can persist far longer than breadth warnings imply, and avoiding it may forfeit the only theme with real flow behind it.

falsifier.text: SMH (memory proxy) adds 8% while GDX is flat or down over the next 20 trading days
